# CloudSeedCore (vendored)

The reverb engine of Cloud Seed by Ghost Note Audio, copied unmodified from
https://github.com/GhostNoteAudio/CloudSeedCore at commit
deb21ded9eb7dad9b3ff94ce1ba96a963716594e (22 Sep 2024).

Licence: MIT (see LICENSE). 8track's Reverb effect builds on it, adding its own shimmer
(a pitch-shifted feedback loop). CloudSeed.h and CloudSeed.cpp are 8track's: they supply the
build settings the original sets on the compiler's command line.
